title: Frosted sweetbread
content:
# Frosted sweetbread

Type: Food | Internal ID: VikingCupcake | Source: Stone oven | Usage: Crafting, Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Unbaked sweetbread x1 | Max Health: 43 | Max Stamina: 43 | Duration: 30m | Healing: 4 hp/tick

# Introduction

Frosted sweetbread is a Plains-tier balanced food.

## Recipe

An unbaked sweetbread is produced in a Food preparation table with:
• 2 Cloudberries
• 1 Egg
• 1 Barley flour
• 1 Honey
Frosted sweetbread is produced by unbaked sweetbread in a Stone oven for 50 seconds. If left in the oven for 100 seconds, it will burn and turn into Coal.

Categorias: Food, Materials
